messages:
maya: FYI onboarding Nocturne v1.1-int6 failed locale-mix run. Mixed zh+ar+emoji cases show inserted invisible joiners and mirrored parentheses. sacreBLEU delta ~ -5.1 vs fp32.
dario: ouch. quick repro?
maya: minimal payload used in suite:
```json
{
  "src": "今天输出: ١٢٣ (check) 😊",
  "lang": "zh-ar_emoji_mixed"
}
```
staging returned: "今天输出١٢٣  )check( \ud83d" — note a U+000C filler before arabic digits, RLM (U+200F) before paren got mirrored and emoji surrogate split.
chen: token dump from int6 job: TOKENS: ["今天","输出","\u000c","\u0661","\u0662","\u0663","\u200f","\u0029","check","\u0028","\ud83d","\ude0a"] fp32 tokens: ["今天输出",":" ,"\u0661\u0662\u0663","(check)","\ud83d\ude0a"]
dario: looks like a placeholder/filler (\u000c) sneaked in and token boundaries shifted, causing sanitizer to mirror paren and split emoji. Where could \u000c come from?
maya: dug into qpack artifacts: qpack concat_segments produced 0x0C when concatenating segment buffers after quant packing for int6 because the buffer copy used memset + off-by-one length when source_len==dest_len edge-case. Essentially a stale byte leaked.
chen: oof. so quant pack created an accidental control byte that the tokenizer later mapped to placeholder token and runtime mirrored nearby punctuation.
dario: propose fix: (1) tight patch to qpack.concat_segments to use memcpy with explicit lengths, also sanitize resulting buffer by dropping control bytes in Unicode range < 0x20 except legitimate whitespace; (2) runtime guard: skip fast-bidi-mirror if prev_script_is_cjk; (3) add unit to locale-mix-suite covering zh+ar+emoji+parens.
maya: opened branch fix/nocturne-int6-qpack-concat-3187 and added tests.
ci-bot: CI smoke triggered for fix/nocturne-int6-qpack-concat-3187.
dario: small heads-up: adding the sanitization step may change a few token offsets; we should run a quick eval to ensure no other regressions.
chen: ran local smoke after patch: tokens now ["今天输出", ":", "\u0661\u0662\u0663", "(check)", "\ud83d\ude0a"] and sacreBLEU delta -0.2 vs fp32. emoji intact.
deploy-bot: deploy queued eng-ml/staging -> fix/nocturne-int6-qpack-concat-3187 by maya. ETA ~11m.
l10n-bot: please add this case to onboard gate for int6/int8/int4 sweeps.
dario: will add to locale-mix-suite v5 and nightly regression. Also log a short onboarding note specifying qpack concat assumptions and sanitizer "prev_script" check.
maya: reproducible curl command for staging smoke:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://staging-eval.internal/run -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"nocturne-v1.1-int6","suite":"locale-mix-v5","case":"zh_ar_emoji_paren_01"}'
```
ci-bot: CI artifacts available in ~8m; nightly locale-mix-v5 scheduled after merge.
chen: follow-ups: backport qpack fix to other quant candidate branches, add memcheck in packaging CI, and add a tiny micro-benchmark to keep sanitizer guard cheap.
dario: thanks for the quick triage. Nice catch. :clap:
maya: leaving thread open until nightly green. will post one-line update in #eng-ml when stable.
